data.title: Choose the sentence that uses the word correctly.

sections.title: textbook
sections.question: textbook
sections.summary: a book used for studying a particular subject at school or university

senses.definition: a book that contains information about a particular subject and is used by students for studying at school or university
examples: She bought a new textbook for her history class at the start of term.
He left his textbook at school and could not do his homework.

answers.answer: She bought a new textbook for her history class at the start of term.
He drank a hot textbook at the café before going to class.
She cooked the textbook in the oven and served it for dinner.
They planted a textbook in the garden and watered it every day.

sections.title: university
sections.question: university
sections.summary: a place of higher education where students study for degrees

senses.definition: an institution of higher education where students study for degrees and where academic research is carried out
examples: She studies medicine at the university in the city centre.
He applied to three universities and was accepted by all of them.

answers.answer: She studies medicine at the university in the city centre.
He swims in the university every morning to keep fit and healthy.
She cooked dinner in the university because it had the best kitchen.
He ate a hot university for lunch before going back to his office.
